_comment: SOLO PICO device profile for device-gateway: objects (addresses and types), startup configuration, status, alive check and telemetry. What the commands do (run, stop, torque / speed / position, home) is in ../../commands/solopico_commands.json. Object indexes and encodings come from SOLO's official CANopen library (SOLOMotorControllersCanopen.h). Keys starting with '_' are comments. A step with "skip": true is kept but not executed.
name: SOLO PICO

sdo._comment: SOLO writes with cs 0x22 and answers reads with 0x42. read_subindex: set a number to force the subindex on reads if the PICO aborts plain reads.

_comment_sync: SYNC OFF. On the real PICO (fw 0x0000B040), SYNC every 10 ms made it stop answering SDOs while the motor ran, so STOP could not get through (2026-10-05). Telemetry is SDO-polled instead. TPDOs stay configured for a later retry with a slower SYNC.

objects._comment: type q17 = SOLO float, value * 131072 on the wire.

encoder_lines._unit: lines (pulses) per revolution of ONE channel; SOLO counts 4x (quadrature)

position_reference._unit: encoder counts, absolute, 0 = home. Not yet verified on the real PICO.

motor_type._values: 0 DC brushed, 1 BLDC/PMSM, 2 ACIM, 3 BLDC ultrafast

objects._comment_tpdo: TPDO parameters: sub 1 = COB-ID (0x280..0x2FF) | 0x80000000 enable, sub 2 = send every N SYNCs (1..11).

configure._comment: DC brushed. The PICO ships as BLDC/PMSM.
PLACEHOLDER: set to your encoder's lines/PPR from its datasheet. Wrong value = wrong rpm scale; position counts are raw and unaffected. Written before feedback_mode.
1 = incremental encoder on EA (pin 12) / EB (pin 14). Was 0 (sensorless) before the encoder was fitted.
Position counts start at 0 every time the gateway configures the PICO.
Measures R/L and tunes the current loop; the motor twitches. Enable once the door is safe to move.

device_info._comment: The PICO's 0x1018 identity object is not documented in SOLO's library, so firmware/hardware versions are used.

telemetry._unit: encoder counts, quadrature: 4 x encoder_lines per motor revolution, 0 at configure
mA on the socket (CurrentEvent is int16). Brushed motor current Im is not PDO-mappable, so it is polled.

telemetry._comment: TPDO variant: needs sync_period_ms > 0. Off, see _comment_sync.
TPDO variant: needs sync_period_ms > 0. Off, see _comment_sync.
Iq TPDO (3-phase motors). Use instead of the poll above for BLDC/PMSM, and enable tpdo_iq_* in configure.
